name: uyirly-lab-connector
description: Sits on a laboratory PC, takes what the analyzers say, and gets it to Uyirly without losing anything.

scripts.test: tsx test/link.test.ts && tsx test/mllp.test.ts && tsx test/half-open.test.ts && tsx test/dicom-worklist.test.ts && tsx test/dicom-store.test.ts && tsx test/disk.test.ts && tsx test/render.test.ts && tsx test/link.auth.test.ts && tsx test/tunnel.test.ts && tsx test/files.test.ts && tsx test/pair.test.ts

comment: Deliberately kept out of the app's package.json and out of its tsconfig,
for the same reason Playwright is: nothing here should ever be installed
on the production server. This is a program a hospital runs on its own PC.
serialport is optional because it is a native module — it cannot be baked
into a single-file executable, and a connector whose analyzers are all on
the network must still run without it.
